result.summary: Found 4 issues including cut-off content and layout inconsistencies affecting the browsing experience.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card in the Fastest near you section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, hiding its delivery time and price info
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll carousel properly clips or shows a partial card indicator, and confirm full card content is accessible via scroll

issues.description: Category pills (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off at the right edge suggesting more categories exist off-screen without a clear scroll affordance
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (fade gradient or arrow) indicating the row is scrollable

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the navigation bar, making it look unfinished
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing/margin so cards don't feel truncated by the fixed bottom navigation, or add fade effect

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated due to card width, making it hard to read full name
issues.suggestion: Increase card width or use text truncation with ellipsis and tooltip/full name on tap
